title: Laddu, Chintu and the Gobbled Shopping List
moral: When we help at home, everyone smiles together.
description: Dadaji is cooking a big dinner, so Laddu and Chintu race off to the Masti Nagar market to help. But Golu the goat gobbles the shopping list! Can the boys remember which foods are fruits and which are vegetables? Learn fruits and vegetables with Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu in this funny animated story about helping at home for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.speaker: chintu

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Three fruits and three vegetables. It's all on this list... zzzzz...

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just... resting my eyes!

narration.text: Off they went down the lane, holding the list up high. Skip, skip, skip!
But then... jingle, jingle! Out popped Golu the goat from behind a rickshaw!

narration.speaker: golu
narration.text: Ba-a-a-a!
CHOMP! Golu gobbled up the shopping list! Munch, munch... GULP!
Laddu grabbed. Whoops! Chintu grabbed. Whoops! Then they both grabbed... BONK! They bumped heads!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Ow! Now what do we buy?
The boys sat under the banyan tree. Think, think, think!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: IDEA! I remember! Fruits are usually sweet and juicy, with seeds inside!

narration.speaker: chintu
narration.text: And vegetables are other parts of a plant, like roots and leaves!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Sweet and juicy? I know one! A jalebi is a fruit!
Ha ha ha! No, Laddu! A jalebi is a sweet made in a pan. Fruits grow on plants!

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Hmm. Then I'll dream about jalebis.

narration.text: Masti Market was busy and bright! Look at the stripy roofs!

A BANANA! Yes! You are so smart!
Then an orange MANGO and a red APPLE! Let's count. One, two, three fruits!
But Golu munched a banana and dropped the peel. Chintu stepped on it... wheeeee... SPLAT!

TWEEEEET! Pinky whistled so loud, a parrot tumbled off its branch... and flapped back up!

narration.text: Let's share the load. One thing each!
Laddu carried the fruits, Chintu carried the potatoes, and Pinky wore the spinach like a fancy hat!

narration.text: Back home, guess what? Dadaji was fast asleep by the stove! Zzzzz!
So the friends got busy. Wash, wash, wash the vegetables! Sweep, sweep, sweep!
Laddu set out the plates. His tummy rumbled so loudly, it woke Dadaji up!

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: I'm awake! I was just resting my eyes! Ho ho HO! You did ALL this for me?

narration.speaker: laddu
narration.text: Yes! Helping you is fun, Dadaji!
Dadaji's big moustache wiggled with joy. Wiggle, wiggle!

narration.text: That night, everyone sat together under twinkly lights for dinner.

narration.speaker: dadaji
narration.text: Thank you, my little helpers. When we all help at home, dinner tastes extra yummy!

narration.speaker: pinky
narration.text: And it was fun, too! Like a big team game!
